title: Superpower membership
description: The single-plan sign-up section. On desktop a large square gallery with a row of seven thumbnails stays pinned at the left while the right column runs: avatars and boxed green stars with a rating, a big regular-weight plan name, a grey lead, a huge price with '/year', a checklist with ink check circles, a full-width near-black pill, a row of small facts, grey footnotes, a grey card of three survey figures, and hairline FAQ rows. On phones it all stacks, gallery first. Clicking a thumbnail swaps the main image.
notes: the gallery is sticky on desktop; thumbnails need JavaScript to swap the main image
